title: 第11章 八岁赚大钱第12章 第三次模拟妙笔生花
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: “枫子，你不是说最近没时间，来不了斗兽场吗，怎么现在有时间过来了？”
叶明月一边大口吃着鸡腿，同时问道。
叶枫没有直接回答叶明月的问题，而是转移换题道：“我来斗兽场是来找你的，顺便散散心，我有小道消息，与你有关的你要不要听？”
“与我有关？什么消息，枫子你就别卖关子了，一点不敞亮，快说，快说。”
听到叶明月心急的话，叶枫缓缓的说道：“你哥哥我可是听说了啊，月子你与林家定亲的对象有三个，到时候你可以从这三位林家女子中选择一个或者两个。”
说完叶枫停顿了一下，面带微笑的伸手看向叶明月。
眼见叶枫的这个动作，了解他的叶明月哪能不清楚他的意思，丢了五枚天炎铜币给他。
“赶紧说，要是事后让哥哥我知道你这消息不实，看我回头不揍你。”
收下五枚制作精巧的铜币后，叶枫也没有再吊着他：“这三人，分别是林家的二长老的嫡孙女林苗、林家三长老的小女儿林雨、以及林家五长老的独生女林淼。”
说完不等叶明月说话，继续道：“据我了解到，其中性情最好的恰好是家世最差的林淼，虽然订婚这种事情他人最好是不要介入，但身为兄弟的我还是要给你提一句，你可以多了解了解，不要直接作下决定。
正好林家现在还未把消息给你，现在你有时间去了解她们三人，毕竟伴侣是关系到你一辈子的事情，慎重一点没有错。”
叶枫之所以这么建议，就是因为二次模拟中叶明月选择了家世好的林苗，身为兄弟的叶枫在驻守霄铁矿脉资源点的时候，听到了叶明月的诉苦。
林苗看似性格温婉，实则极为骄横，仗着自己是林家二长老的孙女，丝毫没有把叶明月的父母看在眼里。
但叶明月待林苗还是极好，除了日常资源外，大多给了妻子。
然后让叶明月没有想到的一件事情是，在叶明月达到练脏境的时候，想要取出部分资源，换取材料制作一件趁手的武器，这样前往驻守资源点的时候才会安全点，没想到数十年存在妻子林苗这里的资源，尽数被她交给了她弟弟，竟是一点没有留给叶明月。
当然事情的原因叶枫现在并没有讲给叶明月听，毕竟事情没有发生，而据他了解林家五长老的独生女林淼对待夫家确是极好。
而叶明月在听到叶枫的话后，很快就想起母亲此前问过自己的话，其中就有这三位女孩子，当时没有怎么注意，现在一想确实极为可信，而且枫子从来没有骗过自己，叶明月当即也是相信了，想到这里，叶明月回头与随身的护卫说了些话，很快跟随叶明月的护卫，就离开了一个。
在叶枫看来，想必是叶明月安排去调查三位女子的信息去了。
随后，两人就有说有笑的看着斗兽场中的情景，期间叶明月经常有进行押注，但看了十多场下来，叶枫还是没有投入进去一个铜币。
一直到一个多时辰之后，叶枫才看到了自己等待的今天第一个目标出现了。
此次投注，叶明月与他意见相反，因为就场面来看，叶明月选择的那头妖兽确实更为强大一些。
虽然叶枫看起来也这么感觉，但还是选择押注了另外一头妖兽。
很快两头妖兽的战斗结果出来了，叶枫选择的没有错，小赚了一笔。
这更让他确信自己的信息没有错。
很快他看中的第二头妖兽也上场了，这次他把自己此次携带的钱全部放了进去。
看中叶枫的行为，叶明月惊呆了，“枫子你是不是疯了啊，玩这么大，你不怕昌明叔叔打你吗？”
听到叶明月的话，他没有回复，只是淡淡的笑着。
看到叶枫这么有自信，虽然不清楚是怎么回事，但总感觉一向聪明沉稳的叶枫肯定是得到了什么消息，随后叶明月也是咬了咬牙，把自己二分之一的家底投了进去。
虽然两人投的钱不少，但在丰元斗兽场进行投入的人很多，相比之下显得又没有那么多。
而在看到斗兽结果的时刻，叶枫也是松了一口气，这次赌对了。
与他表现出来的冷静不同，叶明月直接不淡定了，居然准备亲叶枫一口，还好现在叶枫修为比他高，不然真要被恶心好几天了。
也怪不了叶明月不淡定，此次因为他们押注的一方人数稀少的原因，直接翻了八倍。
在叶明月看来，叶枫肯定是知道了什么消息，不然不会这么自信，当即大笑着对叶枫说道：“枫子，下次有这种好事一定记得叫上哥过来，我们可是好兄弟呀。”
叶枫看着兴奋的叶明月，“哪里可能天天有这样的好事情。”
说完叶枫就离开了斗兽场。
此后的几天时间，叶枫也还是来到了丰元斗兽场，而叶明月也是跟着叶枫来此赚了不少。
在赚了足足七天后，叶枫任叶明月如何说破天，都没有再去斗兽场了，因为他清楚，有些事情适可而止即可，赚的差不多就够了，再多就会有一些不好的事情发生。
即使自己是叶家嫡系，但也有一个量在里面。
看着袋子里面的秘银币，叶枫也有点忍不住笑意，这些银币应该是购买到十九种制作‘益骨生根宝丹’的宝药了，只是还是需要家族的力量才能去买回来，剩余的部分钱也够自己用很长一段时间购买丹药修炼了。
而就在叶枫将钱交给父亲叶昌明的时候，叶昌明整个人都懵了，虽然他也被城主府的人找过，告诉他叶枫在丰元斗兽场赚了不少钱，让叶枫收手，但他是真没想到赚了这么多。
对此，叶昌明内心极为的欣慰，此后几天见朋友就说，“我儿叶枫，八岁能赚钱！”
同时他也没有忘记正事，与叶家三祖商量过，为叶枫找寻剩余几种难获取的宝药。

content_en:
"Fengzi, didn't you say you haven't had time recently and can't come to the Colosseum? Why do you have time to come now?"
Ye Mingyue asked while eating chicken legs.
Ye Feng did not directly answer Ye Mingyue's question, but changed the subject and said: "I came to the Colosseum to find you and take a break. I have some gossip, do you want to hear it related to you?"
"Is it related to me? What news? Fengzi, please stop being secretive and don't be open at all. Tell me quickly. Tell me quickly."
Hearing Ye Mingyue's anxious words, Ye Feng said slowly: "I've heard about your brother. Yuezi, you have three betrothal partners to the Lin family. When the time comes, you can choose one or two from these three Lin family women."
After speaking, Ye Feng paused and stretched out his hand to look at Ye Mingyue with a smile.
Seeing Ye Feng's action, Ye Mingyue, who knew him well, could not understand what he meant, so she threw five Tianyan copper coins to him.
"Hurry up and tell me, if my brother and I know that your news is untrue, I will beat you later."
After accepting the five exquisitely crafted copper coins, Ye Feng stopped hanging on him: "These three people are Lin Miao, the granddaughter of the second elder of the Lin family, Lin Yu, the youngest daughter of the third elder of the Lin family, and Lin Miao, the only daughter of the fifth elder of the Lin family."
After finishing speaking, Ye Mingyue continued, "As far as I know, the one with the best temperament happens to be Lin Miao, who has the worst family background. Although it is best for others not to get involved in matters such as engagement, as a brother, I still want to remind you that you can learn more and don't make a decision directly.
It just so happens that the Lin family hasn't given you the news yet. Now you have time to get to know the three of them. After all, your partner is something that affects you for the rest of your life. There is nothing wrong with being cautious. "
The reason why Ye Feng suggested this was because Ye Mingyue chose Lin Miao from a good family in the second simulation. As a brother, Ye Feng heard Ye Mingyue's complaints when he was stationed at the Xiao Iron Ore Resource Point.
Lin Miao seemed to have a gentle personality, but in fact she was extremely arrogant. Because she was the granddaughter of the second elder of the Lin family, she did not take Ye Mingyue's parents seriously at all.
But Ye Mingyue still treated Lin Miao very well. Except for daily resources, most of them were given to his wife.
Then one thing that Ye Mingyue didn't expect was that when Ye Mingyue reached the Zang training realm, she wanted to take out some resources in exchange for materials to make a handy weapon, so that she would be safer when going to the resource point. Unexpectedly, all the resources that had been stored in her wife Lin Miao's for decades were handed over to her brother, and none of them were left to Ye Mingyue.
Of course, Ye Feng has not told Ye Mingyue the reason for the incident now. After all, it did not happen. According to his understanding, Lin Miao, the only daughter of the fifth elder of the Lin family, treats her husband's family very well.
After Ye Mingyue heard Ye Feng's words, she quickly remembered what her mother had asked her before, including these three girls. She didn't pay much attention to them at the time. Now that she thought about it, it was indeed very credible, and Fengzi had never lied to herself. Ye Mingyue believed it immediately. Thinking of this, Ye Mingyue turned around and said something to the bodyguards who were with him, and soon followed Ye Mingyue's bodyguards and left one.
In Ye Feng's opinion, Ye Mingyue must have arranged to investigate the information about the three women.
Afterwards, the two of them talked and laughed while watching the scene in the Colosseum. During this period, Ye Mingyue often made bets, but after watching more than ten games, Ye Feng still did not invest a single copper coin.
It was not until more than an hour later that Ye Feng saw the first target he had been waiting for today appear.
Ye Mingyue had the opposite opinion on this bet, because judging from the scene, the monster Ye Mingyue chose was indeed more powerful.
Although Ye Feng seemed to feel the same way, he still chose to bet on another monster.
Soon the result of the battle between the two monsters came out. Ye Feng made the right choice and made a small profit.
This made him more confident that his information was correct.
Soon the second monster he was interested in came on the scene, and this time he put in all the money he had brought.
Seeing Ye Feng's behavior, Ye Mingyue was shocked, "Fengzi, are you crazy? You are playing so big, aren't you afraid that Uncle Changming will beat you?"
Hearing Ye Mingyue's words, he didn't reply, just smiled lightly.
Seeing that Ye Feng was so confident, although he didn't know what was going on, he always felt that the always smart and calm Ye Feng must have gotten some news. Then Ye Mingyue gritted his teeth and invested half of his family fortune.
Although the two invested a lot of money, there were many people investing in Fengyuan Colosseum, but in comparison there were not that many.
When he saw the result of the beast battle, Ye Feng also breathed a sigh of relief. This time he made the right bet.
Different from the calmness he showed, Ye Mingyue lost his composure and actually prepared to kiss Ye Feng. Fortunately, Ye Feng was now higher in cultivation than him, otherwise he would have been disgusted for several days.
It's no wonder that Ye Mingyue is not calm. This time, because the number of people on the side they bet on is so small, the amount has increased eightfold.
In Ye Mingyue's opinion, Ye Feng must have known something, otherwise he would not be so confident. He immediately laughed and said to Ye Feng: "Fengzi, remember to call me next time something good like this happens. We are good brothers."
Ye Feng looked at the excited Ye Mingyue and said, "How can such good things happen every day?"
After saying that, Ye Feng left the Colosseum.
In the next few days, Ye Feng still came to Fengyuan Colosseum, and Ye Mingyue also followed Ye Feng here and made a lot of money.
After making money for seven full days, Ye Feng did not go to the Colosseum anymore no matter what Ye Mingyue said about Po Tian, ​​because he knew that some things were just enough, and the money was almost enough. If there was more, some bad things would happen.
Even though he is a direct descendant of the Ye family, there is still a limit to it.
Looking at the mithril coins in the bag, Ye Feng couldn't help but smile. These silver coins should have bought nineteen kinds of elixirs for making the 'bone-boosting and root-boosting elixirs'. However, it still requires the strength of the family to buy them back. The remaining money is enough for him to buy elixirs for a long time to practice.
And when Ye Feng handed the money to his father Ye Changming, Ye Changming was completely confused. Although he was also approached by people from the City Lord's Mansion, who told him that Ye Feng had made a lot of money at Fengyuan Colosseum and asked Ye Feng to stop, he really didn't expect to make so much.
Ye Changming was extremely happy about this. When he saw his friends in the next few days, he said, "My son Ye Feng can make money at the age of eight!"
At the same time, he did not forget about business. He discussed with the third ancestor of the Ye family to find the remaining few hard-to-obtain precious medicines for Ye Feng.
